idea-plugin.name: Enkidu Linkage Doctor
idea-plugin.description: Enkidu catches runtime linkage failures early before they reach production.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Added

  • ServiceLoader / SPI validation: detects broken META-INF/services/* entries (missing service/provider, type mismatch, non-instantiable providers) and flags packaging overwrite/merge risks.
  • Duplicate-class impact analysis: compares winner vs shadowed copies using bytecode hash + public ABI shape; highlights dangerous shadowing vs benign identical duplicates.
  • MRJAR-aware class/service/module-info resolution (effective runtime view) with runtimeJavaFeature override.
  • Repro bundle output for enkidu doctor via --bundle (zip or directory) including ordered classpath.txt, targets.txt, and bundle.json.
  • Jar scan cache keyed by SHA-256 for fast repeat scans on large classpaths.
  • Parallel jar indexing with bounded concurrency.
  • Streaming target analysis with bounded in-flight work to reduce memory pressure.
  • CLI performance knobs: jar parallelism, target parallelism, in-flight limits, optional cache directory.
  • continueOnError best-effort mode with deterministic warnings and execution context reporting.
  • Extended evidence in JSON / SARIF / HTML / IntelliJ reports to include SPI and duplicate-risk details.

Improved

  • More resilient handling of unreadable jars, manifests, and invalid bytecode; surfaced as structured warnings.

Fixed

  • JarIndex winner selection now strictly follows classpath order across directories and jars.
  • Artifacts v1 JSON deserialization is now forward-compatible (unknown fields ignored).
